tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud nas bshad pa'i yul chen rnams kyi sgrig tshul thun mong ba bla ma'i man ngag gsal bar bshad pa dpyod ldan dgyes pa'i me tog 'phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru badz+ra dhā ra he badz+ra bud+dha dh+wa dza ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang kyai rdo rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /so bdun yul gyi rtser son he ru ka /rgyud don 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /chos mig rdul bral spyan ldan bla ma rje/ /nam yang 'bral med phyag 'tshal dus kun srungs/ /rtog ges rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa dang / /rgyud don bla ma'i zhal las rtogs dgos zhes/ /ched du shes phyir so bdun yul gyi don/ /dkrugs pa deng 'dir gsal bar bdag gis bkod/ /gnas la u rgyan 'phur 'gro ste rgya gar gyi nub na yod/ spyi bo dza lan dhar/ / 'bar ba 'dzin pa ste kha med rgya gar gyi bar na yod/ spyi gtsug yin no ko la gi ri ni/ ste lho nub/ ma tshogs ma kaṃ rus na ko la pu ṣi grong khyer yongs su mi ra lo/ 'dod pa'i gzugs te rgya gar lho phyogs na yod/ smin phrag bzhi bgrod pas/ /rab dga' dang po'i sa der mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /nye gnas mā la wa ni 'phreng ba can te lho'i gling phran/ sna rtse ste/ /sin+dhu nub phyogs nas 'bab bzhin pa'i chu bo'i 'gram/ mig gnyis nā ga ra ni rna/ /lcags siṅga gling / pa'i brang ni kha ste bzhi bgrod pas/ / zhes pa thams cad 'di'o/ /dri ma med pa gnyis par rkang pa bkod/ /zhing la mum+mu ni lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi rgyal khams/ ste o ko dang / /de wi ko ṭa lha mo'i mkhar ste rdo rje gdan gyi shar na yod/ mgrin pa gnyis bgrod pas/ /gsum pa 'od byed sar 'god nye ba'i zhing / /ku lu ta rigs dang ldan pa lho nub na rdo pus mo lta bu yod pa/

ste rgyab tshigs arbu ta/ mchod 'os te lho phyogs kyi rgyud na yod pa rdo mchog grong khyer/ /nu ma gnyis bgrod bzhi pa 'od 'phro thob/ /tshan+dho ha ri ke la nam mkha'i shing sde shar lho na yod pa bha ga bha ma'i bye brag snying kha dang / /go da ba ri ba'i mchog sbyin ri lho phyogs dpal gyi ngos na yod/ lte ba gnyis bgrod pas/ /lnga pa sbyangs dka' ba ni thob par 'gyur/ /nye tshan lam pa ka 'phyangs pa can te shar lho na yod pa/ ni gsang ba'i nang / kan+tsi skyur bag can te lho nub na yod pa/ rtags kyi dbus te gser gling che ba mis bzung ba de yin/ gnyis bgrod pas/ /drug pa mngon du gyur pa'i sa la dbang / /'du ba byed pa'i gnyis lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i gling phran/ te rtags kyi rtse/ /gser gling lho phyogs mi med pa'i gser gling dang ldan pa 'dres bzung ba/ zhang kha de gnyis bgrod pa las/ /bdun pa ring du song ba'i sa la dbang / /nye 'du koṅka lho phyogs na mchog dang byon yod pa mahā bim+bha ste sku gzugs chen po/ na ni brla gnyis te/ /bin+dha ste sgrol ma bzhugs pa'i gnas 'bigs byed/ pus mo de gnyis bgrod pa las/ /brgyad pa mi g.yo'i sa de thob par 'gyur/ /dur khrod rab song 'dus pa byin pa gnyis/ / pre ta paṅga ste srog gsod pa'i ro mang du 'dus/ dur khrod rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yi dwags dngos su rgyu ba/ ste rkang bol gnyis/ /bgrod pas dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros thob/ /nye ba'i dur khrod tsa ri tra ste rgya gar lho phyogs bye brag zhes pa/ /sor mo rgya mtsho'i gling phran bu mo kho na gnas pa/ rnams dang gzhon nu'i grong khyer bzhin/ /mthe bong gnyis yin 'di gnyis bgrod pa las/ /bcu pa chos kyi sprin de thob par gyur/ /'thung spyod grong khyer kha che'i bye brag

phrag pa grong mthar mon yul gyi bye brag gnas/ /rkang mthil rgya mtsho'i nang skyes snying kha'i phyogs/ /sau raṣ+ṭa yul phyogs bzang po ste nub phyogs sa ba na tha da yod pa/ nyid snying kha'i phyogs de bzhi/ /bgrod pas bcu gcig dpe med sa de thob/ /nye ba'i 'thung spyod gangs ri hi ma la ya ste bal bod mtshams/ ltag pa ste/ /ko sa la ni mdzod len te rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub mnyan yod kyi cha/ rnyed pa ka liṅka/ smra ba'i rtags te lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /skyed tshal rdzing rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i skyed tshal yin/ bu 'di gnyis snying kha phyogs/ /bsgrod pas bcu gnyis ye shes chen po thob/ /sbas pa'i yul lnga des mtshon phyi yi yul/ /bgrod pas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar/ /rtag par bzhugs pas sbas don mthar thug pa'i/ /he ru ka yi go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /de dag kun kyang phyi nang go mtshungs shing / /spyi dang sbas pa'i gzhung las grags pa'i ming / /gsang sngags 'dzin pa spyi la ma grags pa'i/ /brgyud srol bzang po'i khyad chos kho na bas/ /nam yang blun rmongs dbus su 'chal gtam gyis/ /ca cor ma chags lhag bsam dag pa'i blo/ /mkhas pa'i dbus gnas zab don 'di 'dra ba/ /gzhan gyis brjod min bla ma'i drin las thob/ /ces rgyud nas bshad pa'i yul chen rnams kyi sgrig tshul thun mong ba bla ma'i man ngag gsal bar bshad pa dpyod ldan dgyes pa'i me tog phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di yang snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhas pa'i dbang po klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung bzhin/ de'i dngos slob mdar stod kyi mi dbang khyim pa paṇ+ḍi ta dgra 'dul don 'grub rdo rjes zin bris kyi tshul du bkod pa'i yul chen sgrig tshul gyi tho yig ngo mtshar can zhig mdzad 'dug pa mthong ba'i tshe/ sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dpon slob dag la dang ba'i dad pa gong 'phel gyi ngang nas/

sa skya pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis yig cha de nyid gzhir bzhag ste rang gi dran gso brjed tho'i tshul du mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpyod ldan mi dbang bi dza badz+ra gyi phyag sor 'du byed las bskrun pa'o/ /'di sbyar dge bas tshe 'di 'phos ma thag /mkha' spyod bde ldan mngon dga' sogs skyes nas/ /sprul pas sa skya'i rje btsun gsung rab don/ /mu mtha' med par spel ba'i mthu ldan shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i yul chen bsgrig tshul thun mong ma yin pa legs par bshad pa rje btsun mchog gi dgongs rgyan dpyod ldan yongs kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs/ rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra nā tha bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka bud+dha dh+wa dza tsa he badz+ra nai rat+ma ya na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo'i mgon po rje btsun sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang kyai rdo rje bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan yon tan ral pa'i nags kyi khrod/ /legs bshad gaṅgā'i bu mo'i bsti ba'i gnas/ /mdo rgyud zab don dbu ba'i do shal can/ /don gnyen gdung sel 'dren par snying nas bsngags/ /zab mo sngags kyi bstan pa dpyid kyi ni/ /pho nya lung dang rigs pa'i bka' btags kyi/ /'khor lo srid mthar bsgyur ba'i shing rta cher/ /grags pa'i zhabs kyi rgyal mtshan gtsug na rgyal/ /de byin rlabs chen snying zhugs lung rigs kyi/ /rtsa brtan legs bshad 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud/ /phan bde'i grib ma snum po bder 'bab pa'i/ /rnam 'grel ljon pa'i grib bsil 'dir zhugs shig /rgyud sde'i yang snying bye ba'i lam gyi srog /'khrugs ldan e ran+ḍa yi nags klung du/ /ma chags zab don dpal gyi lding khang nas/ /legs bshad dbyangs 'di gzhan gsos bu'i bgo skal/ /zhes mchod brjod dang dam bcas sgo phye nas/ rje btsun lha mo bco lnga yab dgyes mdzad dang bcas pa'i bstod pa rin po che'i 'phreng ba dri ma med pa'i tshig 'bru rna bar 'jam zhing yid la 'bab pa rgyud don gyi snying por gyur pa zhig brjod par bya yi/

skal bzang dpyod ldan dag rna ba blags te nyon cig sa dang po de thob par byed pa la phyi nang gi yul bzhi bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi gzugs phung gti mug mig rnams sbyong byed sa bon ā las byung ba dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi gnas shar du bkod pa'i lha mo rdo rje mas sbyangs shing / rtsa mi phyed ma phra gzugs ma gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa pu dang dza'i rnam pas spyi bo dang spyi gtsug tu gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis dang / de dag nas so dang sen mo'i khams dang / skra dang ba spu'i khams te bdud rtsi gnyis dang / nang gi yul re re nas las rlung drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga pa re re dbu mar thims pas/ phyi'i yul pu li ra ma dang 'bar 'dzin gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing lus tshor gyi dran pa nyer bzhag gnyis mngon du gyur pa dang / yang sbyang gzhi tshor ba ser sna sna rnams sbyong byed i las byung ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi lho phyogs su gnas pa'i lha mo gsang ba'i dkar mos sbyong zhing / rtsa rtse ba ma dang / g.yon pa ma gnyis rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa a a'i rnam pas rna ba g.yas pa dang ltag par gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis dang / de dag nas pags pa dang dri ma'i khams dang sha'i khams gnyis dang / nang gi yul gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin dbu mar thims pas phyi'i yul u rgyan dang arbu ta gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing / sems chos kyi dran pa nyer bzhag gnyis mngon du byas pa las/ rab dga' gnas kyi sa de'i rtogs pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir zhes 'chad pa lapu lir mi phyed so dang sen mo'i khams/ /'bar 'dzin skra gzugs skra dang spu 'bab cing / /gzugs phung gti mug mig sbyong ā las byung / /'khor lo'i shar nas rdo rje ma phyag 'tshal/ /u rgyan rtse ma pags pa dri ma bskyed/ /ar bu g.yon pa ma ste sha 'bab cing / /tshor ba ser sna sna sbyong i las byung / /lho phyogs gsang ba'i dkar mor bdag phyag 'tshal/

/spyi bo spyi gtsug rna ba ltag par gzhung / /lus dang tshor ba chos dang sems kyi dngos/ /rlung dang byang chub sems rnams dbu mar thim/ /gnas de rab dga'i sa la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / de bzhin du sa gnyis pa thob pa la phyi nang gi yul bzhi bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi 'du shes 'dod chags lce rnams sbyong byed sa bon ī las byung ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi nub tu gnas pa'i lha mo chu'i rnal 'byor mas sbyong zhing / rtsa thung ngu ma dang rus sbal skyes ma gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa gau ri gnyis kyi rnam pas rna ba g.yon pa dang smin phrag tu gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis dang / de dag nas chu rgyus dang rus phreng gi khams gnyis dang / nang gi yul de gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin rgyu ba dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i gnas gau ta wa ri dang / rasmi shwa ra gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing / sdig pa ma skyes pa mi skyed pa dang / skyes pa spong ba'i yang dag spong ba gnyis mngon du gyur pa dang / yang sbyang gzhi 'dud byed/ phrag dog lus rnam sbyong byed sa bon u las byung ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi byang du gnas pa'i lha mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas sbyong zhing / rtsa sgom ma dang / dbang ma gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa de ma gnyis kyi rnam pas mig gnyis dang / de dag nas mkhal ma'i khams dang / snying ga'i khams gnyis dang / nang gi yul de gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i gnas de wi ko ṭa dang ma la wa gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing / dge ba ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang skyes pa spel ba'i yang dag spong ba gnyis mngon du gyur pa las gnyis pa dri med nye gnas kyi sa'i rtogs pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir ro zhes 'chad pa la/ go ta wa ri thung ngu chu rgyus 'bab/ /rasmi ru sbal skyes ma rus 'phreng bskyed/ /'du shes 'dod chags lce sbyong ā las byung /

/chu bdag chu yi rnal 'byor ma phyag 'tshal/ /de wi ko ṭar sgom ma mkhal ma bskyed/ /ma lar dbang ma snying 'bab 'dud byed dang / /phrag dog lus sbyong u skyes yang dag spong / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro gnyis pa'i sa la bstod/ /ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung / yang sa gsum pa 'od byed zhing gi sa de thob par byed pa la phyi nang gi yul chen gnyis bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi sa'i khams/ sbyong byed sa bon ū las byung ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'phar ma'i byang shar du gnas pa'i lha mo puk+ka sis sbyong zhing / rtsa skyon ma dang 'jug ma gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa ka o'i rnam pas mchan khung gnyis dang / nu ma gnyis su gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis dang / de dag nas mig gi khams dang mkhris pa'i khams gnyis dang / nang gi yul de gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i gnas ka ma ru pa dang oṃ trai gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro dbang du 'dus shing 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa gnyis mngon du gyur pa las gsum pa 'od byed zhing gi sa de thob pa yin pa'i phyir zhes 'chad pa la/ ka ma ru par skyon ma mig 'bab cing / /o trer mjug ma 'khris pa 'bab pa'i khams/ /ū skyes puk+ka sis sbyong rdzu 'phrul gnyis/ /shar phyogs 'od byed zhing la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / yang sa bzhi pa 'thob pa la phyi nang gi yul gnyis bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi chu'i khams sbyong byed sa bod ṛ las byung ba'i 'phar ma'i shar lhor gnas pa'i lha mo sha wa ris sbyong zhing / rtsa ma mo dang mtshan mo gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa tri ko'i rnam pas lte ba dang sna rtser gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis dang / de dag nas glo ba dang rgyu ma'i khams gnyis dang / nang gi yul gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i gnas tri sha ko ne dang ko sa la gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing /

brtson 'grus kyi dang spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa gnyis mngon du gyur pa las bzhi pa 'od 'phro nye zhing gi sa de'i rtogs pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir zhes 'chad pa la/ tri sha ku ner ma mo glo ba 'bab/ /ko sar mtshan mo rgyu ma chu yi khams/ /ṛ skyes sha wa ris sbyong rdzu 'phrul gnyis/ /shar lho nye zhing 'od 'phro phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / yang sa lnga pa thob pa la phyi nang gi yul chen gnyis bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi me'i khams/ sbyong byed sa bon ṝ las byung ba 'phar ma'i lho nub tu gnas pa'i lha mo tsaṇ+ḍa lis sbyong zhing / rtsa bsil sbyin ma dang tsha ba ma gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa ka la'i rnam pas kha dang mgrin par gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis/ de dag nas chu rgyus dang lto ba'i khams gnyis dang / nang gi yul de gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i gnas ka liṅka dang lam+bha ka'i mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing / dad pa'i dbang po dang brtson 'grus kyi dbang po gnyis mngon du gyur pa las lnga pa sbyang dka' tshan+dho'i sa de'i rtogs pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ ka liṅkir ni bsil sbyin chu rgyus 'bab/ /lam+par tsha ba lto ba 'bab ma me/ /ṝ skyes tsāṇ+ḍa līs sbyong dbang po gnyis/ /lho nub tshan+dha sbyang dkar bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / yang sa drug pa thob pa la phyi nang gi yul chen gnyis bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi rlung gi khams/ sbyong byed sa bon l̥ las byung ba 'phar ma'i nub byang du gnas pa'i lha mo g.yung mos sbyong zhing / rtsa gzhol ma dang rangs ma gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa ka hi'i rnam pas snying ga dang 'dom bar du gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis dang / de dag nas 'bab pa'i bshang ba'i khams dang rus pa'i khams gnyis dang / nang gi yul de gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i gnas kañtsi dang hi ma la ya'i mkha' 'gro dbang du 'dus shing /

dran pa'i dbang po dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po mngon du gyur pa las/ drug pa mngon gyur nye ba'i tshan+dho'i sa de'i rtogs pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ kañtsir gzhol ma bshang 'bab kha ba'i rir/ /rangs ma rus pa'i khams 'bab rlung gi dngos/ /l̥ skyes g.yung mos sbyong zhing dbang po gnyis/ /nub byang mngon gyur nye ba'i tshan+dhor bstod/ /ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung / yang sa bdun pa thob pa la phyi nang gi yul chen gnyis bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi gzugs kyi khams sbyong byed sa bon l̥̄ las byung ba/ 'phar ma'i shar du gnas pa'i lha mo go ris sbyong zhing / rtsa shin tu gzugs can ma dang spyi ma gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa pre gṛ'i rnam pas mtshan ma dang / bshang lam du gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis dang / de dag nas 'bab pa'i bad kan dang rnag gi khams gnyis dang / nang gi yul de gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i gnas pre ta pu ri dang gṛ ha de wa gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing / shes rab kyi dbang po dang dad pa'i stobs gnyis mngon du gyur pa las bdun pa ring song 'du ba'i sa de'i rtogs pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir ro zhes 'chad pa la/ pre tar shin tu gzugs can bad kan 'bab/ /khyim gyi lha ni spyi ma rnag 'bab gzugs/ /l̥̄ skyes gau ri'i sbyong mdzad dbang po stobs/ /shar phyogs 'du ba ring du song bar bstod/ /ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung / yang sa brgyad pa thob pa la yul chen gnyis bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi sgra'i khams sbyong byed sa bon e las byung ba'i 'phar ma'i lho ru gnas pa'i lha mo tsau ri'i sbyong zhing / rtsa rgyus sbyin ma dang sbyong bral ma gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa sau su'i rnam pas brla gnyis dang byin pa gnyis su gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis dang / de dag nas 'bab pa'i khrag dang rdul gyi khams gnyis dang / nang gi yul de gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin dbu mar thim pas/

phyi'i gnas sau raṣ+ṭa dang pu war+ṇa de wa'i mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing / brtson 'grus dang dran pa'i stobs gnyis mngon du byas pa las brgyad pa mi g.yo nye 'du'i sa de'i rtogs pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ sau ras+ṭar ni rgyu sbyin khrag 'bab cing / /gser gling sbyor bral rngul 'bab sgra yi khams/ /e skyes tsau ris sbyong mdzad stobs gnyis lhor/ /mi g.yo nye ba'i 'du bar bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / yang sa dgu pa thob pa la phyi nang gi yul chen gnyis bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi sna'i yul du gyur pa'i dri'i khams/ sbyong byed sa bon ai las byung ba 'phar ma'i nub tu gnas pa'i lha mau bai ta lis sbyong zhing / rtsa sdug gu ma dang grub ma gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa na si'i rnam pas sor mo bcu drug dang bol gong gnyis su gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis dang / de dag nas 'bab pa'i tshil bu dang mchin pa'i khams gnyis/ nang gi yul de gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i gnas na ga ra dang sin+dhu'i mkha' 'gro dbang du 'dus shing ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi stobs gnyis mngon du gyur pa las dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros kyi dur khrod kyi sa de'i rtogs pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir ro zhes 'chad pa la/ na ga rar ni sdug gu tshil bu 'bab/ /sin+dhur grub ma mchin 'bab sna yi yul/ /ai skyes bai ta lis sbyong stobs gnyis nub/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / yang sa bcu pa thob pa la phyi nang gi yul chen gnyis bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi lce yul te ro'i khams/ sbyong byed sa bon o las byung ba'i lha mo ghasma ris sbyangs shing / rtsa 'tshod ma dang yid bzang ma gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa ma ku'i rnam pas mthe bong bzhi dang pus mo gnyis su gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis dang / de dag nas 'bab pa'i mchil ma dang snabs kyi khams gnyis dang /

nang gi gnas de gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i gnas ma ro dang ku mu ta gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro dbang du 'dus shing / dran pa yang dag pa dang chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa byang chub kyi yan lag gnyis mngon du gyur pa las bcu pa chos kyi sprin nye ba'i dur khrod kyi sa de'i rtogs pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ ma ror mtshed mas mchil ma 'bab pa 'dzin/ /ku lur yid bzang snabs 'bab lce yi yul/ /au skyes ghasma ris sbyong byang chub gnyis/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin la 'dud/ /ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung / yang sa bcu gcig pa thob pa la phyi nang gi yul chen bzhi bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi reg bya'i khams/ sbyong byed sa bon oṃ las byung ba dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi 'og tu gnas pa'i lha mo spyod mas sbyong zhing / rtsa gsum bskor ma dang 'dod ma gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa hūm̐ hūm̐ gi rnam pas snying gi rgyab kyi rtsa 'dab gnyis la gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis dang / nang gi gnas de gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin rgyu ba dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i yul lcags grang dang ha ri ke la'i mkha' 'gro dbang du 'dus shing / brtson 'grus yang dag dang / dga' ba yang dag gnyis mngon du byas par gyur pa dang / yang sbyang gzhi chos kyi khams sbyong byed sa bon am̐ las byung ba dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi steng du gnas pa'i lha mo mkha' spyod mas sbyong zhing / rtsa khyim ma dang gtum mo gnyis/ rtsa de gnyis kyi mdud pa hūm̐ hūm̐ gi rnam pa snying ka'i mdun gyi mtshams kyi rtsa 'dab gnyis la gnas pa'i yi ge gnyis/ de dag nas 'bab pa'i rlung lnga dang bdud rtsi gsum 'dres pa khams gnyis dang / nang gi gnas de gnyis nas las rlung sngar bzhin rgyu ba dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i yul lan tshwa rgya mtsho'i nang song dang bzhin du gnyis kyi mkha' 'gro dbang du 'dus shing shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag dang /

ting nge 'dzin yang dag gnyis mngon du byas par gyur pa las bcu gcig dpe med pa 'thung spyod kyi sa'i rtogs pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ gsum bskor 'dod ma reg bya sa spyod sbyong / /au skyes byang chub lam gnyis la btud nas/ /khyil ma gtum mo chos dbyings mkha' spyod sbyong / /au skyes byang chub lam gnyis la phyag 'tshal/ /'di bzhi snying gi 'dab brgyad lte ba yi/ /mtshams nas rlung dang bdud rtsi lnga 'dres 'bab/ /'di rnams dbu mar thim pa 'thung spyod de/ /dpe med ye shes bcu gcig sar phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung / yang sa bcu gnyis pa thob pa la phyi nang gi yul chen bzhi bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi rna ba zhe sdang rnam shes kyi phung po rnams sbyong byed sa bon ā las byung ba/ dkyil 'khor dbus na bzhugs pa'i lha mo bdag med mas sbyong zhing / rtsa kun 'dar ma/ ro ma/ rkyang ma/ bdud bral ma bzhi/ rtsa de bzhi'i mdud pa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gi rnam pas snying ga'i phyi skor gyi phyogs bzhir gnas pa'i yi ge bzhi/ de dag nas rlung dang bdud rtsi lnga 'dres nas yod pa'i khams bzhi dang / nang gi gnas de bzhi nas las rlung sngar bzhin dbu mar thim pas/ phyi'i yul gzhon nu'i grong khyer/ rab song 'dus/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ skyed tshal rdzing bu'i 'gram bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du zhing btang snyoms yan lag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / 'phags lam brgyad las yang dag pa'i lta ba/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa yang dag pa'i ngag gsum ste bzhi mngon du gyur pa las sa bcu gnyis pa ye shes ldan nye ba'i 'thung spyod kyi sa de thob pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ dbus gnas g.yas g.yon rgyab kyi cha la bzhugs/ /kun 'dar ro rkyang bdud bral cha dang bcas/ /khu khrag dri chen dri chu mi rtog skyed/ /'phags pa'i lam gsum byang chub la phyag 'tshal/ /gnas gzhi dbu mar stong las bcu gnyis pa/

/nye ba'i 'thung spyod ye shes chen po ste/ /spang bya kun spangs thob bya kun rdzogs pa'i/ /'khor lo'i dbus na bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rna ba zhe sdang rnam shes phung po sbyong / /sems dag chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /spros bral a las byung ba'i gnyis med mchog /rdo rje bdag med ma dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i gzhung 'di byung / yang sa bcu gsum pa thob pa la phyi nang gi yul lnga bgrod dgos te/ sbyang gzhi shin tu phra ba'i dri ma/ sbyong byed bcom ldan 'das kyis sbyong zhing / rtsa snying gi nang skor sbas pa'i rtsa lnga/ rtsa de dag gi mdud pa bh+rum̐ am̐ dziṃ kham̐ hūm̐ gi rnam pas snying gi dbus dang phyogs bzhir gnas pa'i yi ge lnga/ de dag nas shin tu dwangs pa'i bdud rtsi gsum dang / nam mkha'/ chu/ sa me/ rlung gi rlung ste dwangs ma lnga gtsug tor mchog tu thim pas/ phyi'i sbas pa'i yul lnga zhes pa phyi rdo rje gdan/ nang 'og min/ gsang ba sgrub pa po sangs rgyas pa'i de nyid kyi dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i gnas rnams kyi mkha' 'gro dbang du 'dus shing / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' 'tsho ba/ rtsol ba/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin te lnga dang drug gi cha shas gcig mngon du gyur pa la sa bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa de'i rtogs pa skye ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga bdud bral cha dang bcas/ /snying kha'i dbus gnas gtsug tor mchog tu thim/ /'phags pa'i lam lnga drug pa'i cha yi dngos/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu gsum par phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'di byung ba yin no/ /de ltar sa dang sbyar te snying por dril nas zab don rnams ma sbas par bstan pa yin la/ de dag re re bzhin rgyud dang sbyar ba dang mtha' chod kyi lung rigs 'pho ba dang sbyor ba sogs ni re zhig sba bar bya ba'i gnas so/ /'on kyang dpyod ldan don gnyer byung na rim pas 'chad par spro ba yin no/

/de skad rgyud sde'i yang snying dpyid/ /sa lam rnam gzhag 'khrul med pa/ /gong ma'i gsung gi gsal byed mchog /'chad mkhas dpyod ldan ches dkon yang / /sngon sbyangs dkar ba'i bag chags sad/ /rgyud sde gnad kyi snying po longs/ /gong ma'i byin rlabs snying bzhugs pa/ /ji bzhin smra mkhas kho bo tsam/ /zhes pa rje btsun che dang bdag /rdul dang rdul phran brtsegs mtshungs kyang / /rtsa 'grel legs bshad kun mkhyen gyis/ /srang la bcal kyang lci yang med/ /de skad brjod pa'i mod la ni/ /mkhas rlom gdong gis yongs dud cing / /mgrin pa'i phug na snying gi rtse/ /ro 'dzin rtse dang lhan cig 'dar/ /de phyir blo gsal dpyod ldan rnams/ /legs bshad phreng ba 'di bzung las/ /gong ma'i gsung rab la zhugs dang / /rgyud don snying por lon no kye/ /dge des bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /sa lam 'khrul med 'di bgrod nas/ /skal ba dang 'tshams gdul bya la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /ces rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i yul chen sgrig tshul thun mong ma yin pa legs par bshad pa rje btsun mchog gi dgongs rgyan dpyod ldan yongs kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di yang / snyigs dus kyi sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po mkhas pa'i dbang po klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung bzhin/ de'i dngos kyi slob ma mdar bstod mi'i dbang po khyim pa paṇ+ḍi ta dpyod ldan dgra 'dul don 'grub rdo rjes zin bris kyi tshul du bkod pa'i yul chen sgrig tshul thun mong ma yin pa'i legs bshad kyi yig chung zhig 'dug pa mthong ba'i mod la/ sngon byon pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi mkhas pa bstan skyong gi sbyin bdag dang bcas pas bstan pa'i bya ba 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad 'dug pa'i phyag rjes bzang po 'di 'dra ba ngo mtshar che snyam pa'i skyes bu dam pa de dag la dang 'dod kyi dad pa lhag par 'phel zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrug bzhin pa'i ngang nas/

sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis zin bris kyi yi ge de nyid gzhir bzhag ste/ rang gi dran gso gsal 'debs kyi tshul du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpyod ldan mi'i dbang po shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen rabs yangs shing / lhag par dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis gzhung rgya mtsho la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa/ brtse chen sa skyong bi dza rnam rgyal rdo rje/ badz+ra gyis dad gus gyi sgo nas phyag sor gyi 'du byed las bskrun pa'o/ /'di sbyar dge bas tshe 'di 'phos ma thag /mkha' spyod bde ldan mngon dga' sogs skyes nas/ /sprul pas rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab don/ /mu mtha' med par phyogs kun rgyas byed shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga tam̐// //gcig zhus// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 a myes zhabs/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i yul chen rnams kyi sgrig tshul thun mong ba bla ma'i man ngag gsal bar bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
